item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe Gun Cleaning Kit is the ultimate solution for keeping your firearms in top condition. This comprehensive universal cleaning kit is designed to accommodate a wide range of firearms, from .17 to .45 caliber rifles and handguns to .410 to 12-gauge shotguns. The kit includes a variety of high-quality cleaning tools, such as brushes, mops, rods, and rod handles, all crafted to help you clean your firearm with precision.
description: Rothco’s Deluxe Gun Cleaning Kit is the ultimate solution for keeping your firearms in top condition. This comprehensive universal cleaning kit is designed to accommodate a wide range of firearms, from .17 to .45 caliber rifles and handguns to .410 to 12-gauge shotguns. The kit includes a variety of high-quality cleaning tools, such as brushes, mops, rods, and rod handles, all crafted to help you clean your firearm with precision. Multiple slotted tips and cleaning patches ensure you can reach every nook and cranny of your firearm for a thorough clean. The durable aluminum carrying case, measuring 12.1 inches by 7.9 inches by 2.1 inches, provides convenient organization and portability, making it easy to store and transport your cleaning essentials. Whether you're a gun enthusiast or a casual user, Rothco's Deluxe Gun Cleaning Kit will keep your firearms performing at their best, ensuring reliability and longevity with every use.
